verdict.rationale: Exporting data out of an observability SaaS is a fair question for this product, so the axis applies. The evidence shows OpenTelemetry/OTLP ingestion, which keeps instrumentation portable but only covers data coming in. It also shows an API and MCP tools for managing resources and running queries, but these are building blocks, not a documented bulk export of stored telemetry in open formats. Nothing in the pack documents a full-data export or exit path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
